content: tray_manager 0.9.0 (leanflutter, built on nativeapi C++ core): system tray for Flutter desktop Linux/macOS/Windows; on Linux it is a StatusNotifierItem over D-Bus — works on KDE Plasma (user has KDE), GNOME needs AppIndicator extension; icons: .ico on Windows, PNG on Linux; build needs GTK3/X11/Xi dev files. hotkey_manager 0.4.0 (same author/nativeapi): global hotkeys Linux/macOS/Windows — on Linux uses X11/XWayland or the org.freedesktop.portal.GlobalShortcuts portal on native Wayland (needs a portal provider + matching .desktop app ID), Windows/X11 report key-down only. For dicta on Linux the daemon's existing evdev hotkey already covers global keys; the app only needs tray + window show/hide (window_manager). Windows: hotkey_manager works directly. Sources: pub.dev/GitHub leanflutter — HIGH confidence on facts, MEDIUM on maturity caveats (nativeapi-based 0.4/0.9 versions are recent).
